# Pull request

## Change and reason

Explain the reader-facing result and why it belongs in this learning path.

## Verification

- [ ] Ran `npm test` and recorded relevant example commands/results.
- [ ] Ran `npm run links:external` for changed sources and reviewed their relevance.
- [ ] Reviewed Markdown rendering and any changed Mermaid diagrams.
- [ ] Marked conceptual, working, and planned material accurately.
- [ ] Added primary sources/access dates and attributed adaptations.
- [ ] Included only synthetic data; checked for secrets and private information.

List any checks not run and why. Do not label an example working without evidence.
